skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop vocabulary through class topics and additional reading.
Read for gist, main ideas, and detailed information.
Read critically to identify author's stance and evaluate arguments.
Use strategies such as skimming, scanning, and predicting to enhance reading comprehension.
Write paragraphs with clear structure, topic sentences, supporting details, and concluding sentences.
Write essays with introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion.
Assess and improve own reading and writing skills independently.
Work collaboratively in groups and pairs on reading and writing tasks.
Engage in independent study and self-directed learning.
Identify and correct errors in written work.
Analyze arguments and identify logical fallacies.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate texts.
Write in an academic style, including introductions, body paragraphs, and conclusions.
Take responsibility for individual and group goals.
